killedBy: the screen capture adapter reports an uncaught page error as a FAILED capture, not a saved picture of a broken screen
why: Reports an uncaught page error as a passing capture. Every state here is a screen a player can sit on -- the branded failure screens REPORT a failure, they do not suffer one -- so an exception means the picture is of a page still falling over. Turning that into a saved artifact instead of a failed capture is the quiet-success failure mode the assertion channel exists for. Pinned by a case that drives the real adapter with the child process stubbed through its own `deps.runProcess` seam -- an earlier version named a catalogue test that could not possibly see this and SURVIVED, which is how the gap showed up.
